# The Future of Childcare Basics — fundamentals self-quiz (Advanced, public edition)
# Run: python3 quiz.py
qa = [
    ("What is Positive discipline?", "teaching behavior without punishment"),
    ("What is Nutrition?", "regular balanced meals and snacks"),
    ("State one governing principle of childcare basics.", "Routine and consistency do more than any technique."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
